# h3_vm_placement_group (Data Source)

Looks up a VM placement group by `id`, or by `name` in the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "h3_vm_placement_group" "db" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  name       = "postgres-replicas"
}

output "db_vms" {
  value = data.h3_vm_placement_group.db.vm_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Placement group ID. Set `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Group name. Set `id` or `name`.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID; the provider default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `max_vms` (Number) Maximum number of VMs in the group.
- `strategy` (String) Placement strategy (`spread`).
- `vm_ids` (List of String) IDs of the VMs in the group.
